hypotheses.justification: `[CommRing A]` supplies `[Ring A]`, which has the canonical `Ring.toIntAlgebra` instance. `Algebra ℤ A` is subsingleton (`int_algebra_subsingleton`), so this is the only possible algebra structure. Thus the statement and proof can use the inferred instance instead; this also works for the zero ring.
